threads.body: These example requirements pin `langchain` to an exact version but allow `langchain-openai` to float (`>=1.4.1`). This can cause examples to break later when a newer `langchain-openai` release introduces dependency constraints or behavior changes that aren’t compatible with `langchain==1.3.14`. Consider either (a) pinning `langchain-openai` to a specific tested version (like the tests do), or (b) adding an upper bound (e.g., `<2`) and/or aligning `langchain` to a compatible range so installs remain reproducible.
